items.summary: Legal/compliance disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, affiliate, or advertising monetization. Recommendation: keep private and preview-only; do not send rights outreach or change the gate without human counsel review and owner authorization. Evidence: Woot API documentation confirms access mechanics but not storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, attribution, images, prices, freshness, correction, takedown, affiliate, or advertising rights; current public terms restrict commercial/public listing use. Fleet compliance is mixed: 35 pass, 18 fail, 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, reject-control, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and owner gates remain blocked. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only where it adds no new data collection, credentials, permissions, dependencies, or cross-site behavior. This is risk triage, not legal advice or certification.

Launch-readiness tracking progress: active, 0 of 4 legal tasks evidenced closed. Source-rights baseline is documented but does not establish permission; data-flow and consent evidence are partial; public terms are draft-only. No task is closed. Next evidence actions are concrete: assemble the field-level Woot rights matrix; produce the alert-data retention/deletion/access table; capture deployed consent behavior and GA4 property/data-sharing settings; inventory log fields, vendors, retention, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Keep all applicable technical, security, measurement, and owner gates open.

Data-use review decisions for SearchWoot: Woot deal and price-history data — blocked pending authoritative rights and field-level permission; user alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed pending data inventory, retention, deletion/correction/access, processor terms, consent, and unsubscribe evidence; GA4 analytics — conditional only for explicit-consent measurement, pending deployed consent/withdrawal evidence, GA4 settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and jurisdictional counsel review; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed pending log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. No public sharing, affiliate, advertising, remarketing, or monetization use is approved by this review.

Private and gated-site decision: retain searchwoot.com as private and preview-only. Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net unlaunched and preview-only until each has a dated readiness packet covering ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance, security, measurement boundaries, rollback, and an explicit launch decision. Do not infer readiness from analytics gaps, parked status, or scaffold state; do not publish or monetize while the packet is incomplete.
